description: A pair of rough filters for a stereo signal, one cutting the top of the band and one the bottom

params.text: Sets the frequency above which the signal is cut, with nothing cut at the top of its travel
Sets the frequency below which the signal is cut, with nothing cut at the bottom of its travel
Ties the two cut controls together so that they move as one, keeping the gap between them; its lamp is lit while it is on
Sets how many poles each filter has, 1 to 8; more poles give a steeper slope
Shows the high cut frequency that the voltage at the high cut CV input is setting; the module writes this slider every sample and never reads it, so moving it changes nothing
Shows the low cut frequency that the voltage at the low cut CV input is setting; the module writes this slider every sample and never reads it, so moving it changes nothing

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be filtered
A voltage here takes over from the high cut control, 0V to 10V across its travel
A voltage here takes over from the low cut control, 0V to 10V across its travel

outputs.text: That side of the filtered signal
